stack: docker-compose.reference.yml with the knowledge profile (worker, docling), pgvector/pgvector:pg16 by digest, volumes kept across the switch

before.image: neuron:1.2.0, built from the v1.2.0 release commit 97072d8, KNOWLEDGE_ENABLED=true
before.seeded: one knowledge base with one Markdown document (ready) and 3 threads for alice

after.image: neuron:1.3.0-rc, built from main at ef0b5fc (trafilatura added), KNOWLEDGE_ENABLED=true; API and worker restarted
after.seeded_base: listed with language simple and access owner; its document ready, source_url and fetched_at null
after.search: POST /v1/knowledge/search returns the seeded document's chunk (fake embeddings)
after.web_page: POST .../web-pages with https://peps.python.org/pep-0020/: ready, 10656 bytes, fetched_at set; the top 3 search hits for 'explicit is better than implicit' are its chunks, each with source_url and fetched_at
after.smoke_test_knowledge: passed (ready, invoke, cleanup, knowledge-base, upload, ingest, cite, knowledge-cleanup)

sandbox_notes: Images were built with the session proxy's CA trusted in the builder stage only; the runtime image is the repository Dockerfile's.

This sandbox intercepts outbound TLS. The worker's first fetches failed certificate verification and were retried as fetch_failed, as designed. For the check, the worker ran with the sandbox CA mounted as its system trust store (/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt). A deployment with direct internet access needs no such mount.

The session's disk allowance filled during the first successful fetch (23:05 UTC), so that ingest failed with ingest_failed after the page was stored; the document was deleted and the page added again with space free.
